description: Golden cases for evaluating one tool call against an organization's resolved tool rules (policy.rules.allowedTools / deniedTools / allowedMcpServers from /api/control-plane/gateway/resolve and /gateway/tool-policy). Entries are ASCII case-insensitive globs ('*' any run, '?' one character) matched against the canonical server.tool id or the MCP server id. A deny match always wins; a non-empty allowlist denies everything it does not match; '<deny-all>' matches nothing. Replayed by Core (apps/core/src/org_policy.rs) and the Gateway (apps/gateway/src/policy/tool_policy.rs).

cases.name: a composio deny glob denies a composio action
a composio deny glob does not touch other servers
a non-empty allowlist admits what it matches
a non-empty allowlist denies what it does not match
question mark matches exactly one character
question mark does not match two characters
the deny-all allowlist denies every tool
blank entries are ignored and do not make the allowlist non-empty
the MCP server allowlist denies an unlisted external server
the MCP server allowlist admits a listed external server
the MCP server allowlist does not apply to built-in tools
